name: dotnet-channels

Guide to `System.Threading.Channels`: thread-safe producer/consumer queues with `ChannelWriter<T>` and `ChannelReader<T>`, back-pressure, async streams, and graceful shutdown.

Bounded: `Channel.CreateBounded<T>(capacity)` caps memory; preferred for production. `FullMode`: `Wait` provides reliable back-pressure; `DropOldest`, `DropNewest`, and `DropWrite` discard items. Unbounded: `Channel.CreateUnbounded<T>()` grows without limit and can exhaust memory under load; use only when you control producer rate. .NET 7+ drop modes support an `itemDropped` callback.

Concurrent producers may call `WriteAsync`/`TryWrite` without external locking. Call `Complete()` or `TryComplete()` when no more items will be produced; `TryComplete(error)` propagates errors.
